scripts.build: npm run build -w @lading/shared && npm run build -w @lading/api && npm run build -w @lading/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @lading/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test -w @lading/shared && npm run test -w @lading/api
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @lading/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:push -w @lading/api
